answer: Sybil farms mint keys in one neighborhood. An applicant locks 28.6 at a single vertex for 11 hours and posts 6 ember receipts, each a 20-byte hash of (key, 90s bucket) spaced 13-17 minutes apart, then climbs a 4-step ridge. Each step needs a /18-distinct co-signer unused on that vertex for 3 epochs. Cost is 28.6 plus 0.45 per co-sign (30.4); 40 clones need 1216 locked and 40 disjoint /18s. The ledger checks gaps, unique buckets, and prefixes. Two ticks in one bucket void the ember and keep 3.1. A reused co-signer slashes 40%. A ridge step over 9 minutes late expires the bid and bars 4 epochs.
